$comment: Publication approval for official releases (docs/RELEASING.md). CI publishes only when enabled is true AND every required gate is approved by the owner. Never set approved to true without the decision recorded in note.

applicationLicense.note: Owner decision 2026-11-25: the application is released under the MIT License (LICENSE, shipped as LICENSE.txt). It covers the application's own code only; bundled third-party components keep their own licences (THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt).

ffmpegLgpl.note: Owner decision 2026-11-25: approved as is. The unmodified LGPL v3 FFmpeg build runs as a separate, user-replaceable process; each release ships the LGPL text (THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt) and the source and build pointers (SOURCE.md).

canonRedistribution.note: Owner decision 2026-11-25: the owner confirmed holding Canon's authorization to redistribute the embedded Canon EDSDK DLLs with the application. The EDSDK stays proprietary to Canon and is not covered by the MIT License.

codeSigning.note: No code-signing certificate. Releases are published with signed: false and the website says the executable is not code-signed.
